entities.name: Boc-piperidine heteroaryl
observations: Boc-protected piperidine bearing a diazine/pyrimidine-type heteroaryl methyl substituent; standardized SMILES CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCCC(Cc2ncccn2)C1.

entities.name: Heteroaryl methyl piperidine
observations: Neutral deprotected product represented as c1cnc(CC2CCCNC2)nc1.
Reagent chloride can give the corresponding piperidinium hydrochloride salt experimentally.

entities.name: HCl ether DCM
observations: Hydrogen chloride in diethyl ether with dichloromethane is used for acidic Boc deprotection.

entities.name: Boc deprotection finding
observations: Acid-mediated cleavage removes the tert-butoxycarbonyl group from the piperidine nitrogen, forming the secondary amine; isolation may give the piperidinium chloride salt.
